summary: Proposed 300 MW AI data centre campus by Apatura (applicant Apatura DC Project 5 Ltd) on ~55 acres of Scottish Enterprise-owned land at Glenbervie Business Park, Bellsdyke Road/Stirling Road, Larbert, Falkirk. Full application P/26/0237/FUL validated by Falkirk Council on 4 June 2026; two data centre buildings totalling 128,863 m2 at 25 m height plus an 11,500 m2 substation. Developer claims ~£1bn investment and first power 2028; the application drew ~6,700 objections by the July 2026 consultation close. 'Larbert' and 'Glenbervie' are the same campus — the scheme was relocated from Plean (Stirling) to Glenbervie, Larbert in October 2025.
maturity_explanation: Full planning application P/26/0237/FUL received 29 May 2026 and validated 4 June 2026 by Falkirk Council; status 'Awaiting decision' as of 30 July 2026. Not yet consented.
anticipated_construction_start: 2027 (developer consultation timeline; site remediation from Q3 2026)
anticipated_operational_date: First power 2028 (developer press release); operations commence 2029 (developer consultation timeline)

latest_development.headline: Public consultation period closed with ~6,700 objections recorded on Falkirk Council portal; pre-determination hearing reported to be required before committee decision
